notes.title: Get Ready for the Haunted Party at the End of the World!
notes.notes:
New content out today to help you dress your best for the Haunted Party at the End of the World!

Scattered across the wasteland are four new costumes to collect and fill out Jack's wardrobe. Got a bone to pick? Feeling like a shadow of your former self? Want to yuk it up? Ready to get in touch with your creative side? If so, this update has got you covered - literally! Plus, many new achievements to help you convey just how much of a wasteland-hardened badass you really are!

Happy Halloween! :)
-Trevor

---------

v1.0.14 Update Notes

Features:
--4 new costumes hidden across the wastes
--14 new achievements

Bugs:
--Fixed issue with birthday costume gore not displaying correctly when on elevated areas

notes.title: A Happy Wasteland Birthday!
notes.notes:
New content out today to celebrate Outta Gas turning one year old! Players will find a special costume awaiting them in Jack's wardrobe...

A big thank you to everyone for all your support this past year! It's been an excellent journey. (Maybe Gortymr will whip up some gross birthday cake?)

Happy birthday, Outta Gas!
-Trevor

---------

v1.0.13 Update Notes

New Content:
--Special birthday tux costume added to wardrobe for all players. Why? Because Outta Gas is one year old! Wearing this costume will cause Jack to continually leave bloody gore behind as he stomps around the wasteland. (What else could you get a wasteland-hardened badass that already has it all?) Happy birthday, Jack!

Visuals:
--When harvesting a monster, Jack now leaves some gore splatters behind as he moves. Gruesome!

Bugs:
--Fixed issue with two passive items playing incorrect sound effect on pickup
--Fixed issue in Act 3 where player could become unbound by walls after using stairs
--Fixed crash when starting game with no settings file after 1.0.12 update

notes.title: Add Some Style to Your Slaughter!
notes.notes:
New content out today that brings some style to the wasteland! Also includes new achievements, a ton of updates, quality of life improvements, and bug fixes.

---------

What's this? A beaten-up wardrobe has appeared in Cuddles' tire patch! Look inside its musty depths to access Jack's new costume selection. 

But, wait - it's empty? Of course! What, you think you'd just be given new threads without putting in any work? Think again, sphincter face!

Hidden around the wasteland are new costumes for you to find. So get out there and use those eyeballs of yours! Then, return to the wardrobe and dress Jack up to add more edge (or more embarrassment) to his persona.

Have fun adding some style to your slaughter! :)
-Trevor

---------

v1.0.12 Update Notes

New Content:
--Costumes added for Jack! After finding one, interact with the beat-up wardrobe in the gas station map to try it on and bring some style back to the wasteland! (Note: Jack is contractually obligated to change back to his original party tux during all cutscenes.)

Improvements:
--Jack’s light radius increased to provide more visible area in dark maps
--Extra outer ring added to Jack’s light radius to increase visible area in dark maps
--Player walking speed now increases incrementally to give better feel of motion
--Max player speed increased
--Added option to display game stats in in-game menu
--Locked food items now show with progress indicator in store

Visuals:
--Reworked player low health warning graphic (i.e., blood around edge of screen)
--Player health warning now fades in/out to help attract player attention
--Main menu overlay effect now fades in/out
--Added rounded edges to dialog bubbles
--Notification when picking up empty gas can now shows above Jack’s dialog box instead of behind
--Snak Shak repainted - a special thank you to the mutant painters sent by Mayor Biph from Glowing Hills
--Rubble added to several house maps in Glowing Hills
--Small visual improvements to Glowing Hills houses, metal fences, and other objects
--Glowing Hills now reported to be experiencing a spate of vandalism. Office of Mayor Biph (@GlowingHills) has yet to issue an official statement.
--”Loading” text on program start now animates to show signs of life - how official-looking! :o

Bugs:
--Removed barrel from Glowing Hills map that caused player to become stuck
--Added chainsaw attack and select sfx to correct audio group so they should now play at correct volume level
--Fixed issue with smart gun being usable when no ballistic ammo left
--Fixed issue with lighter upgrades not giving stat bonus - players that previously picked them up should be able to go and pick them up again to fix issue
--Fixed issue with main menu web links opening broken web link - big thank you to Vadim
(@YellowAfterlife) for providing an extension online that provides a workaround!
--Added some missing wall/prop control on Act 4 refinery maps
--Save file game world location added for specific Act 1 map
--Fixed some tiling depth and consistency issues
--Fixed issue where player could become stuck when moving against/into certain wall configurations

Audio:
--Adjusted attack/select sound of specific secret weapon to help prevent audio popping
--New SFX added for fast travel system

Achievements:
--7 new achievements added!

Other:
--Crates now break a little faster to allow for smoother interaction. Speedrun world record now in jeopardy! ;)
--Bonus food items now show with ‘FREE’ as price instead of ‘0’

notes.title: Halloween Comes to the Wasteland!
notes.notes:
New content out today that brings SPOOKS to the wasteland!

Those returning alive from the Glowing Hills graveyard report of a hidden path that leads to an evil cottage lurking in the mists, haunted by the stupidest of ghostly specters. And, just beyond reach, some spotted an archaic item that promises the power to shape your frag grenades with spooky delight! 

Will you brave the forgotten and haunted corners of the wastes? Happy Halloween! :)
-Trevor

---------

v1.0.11 Update Notes

Features:
--New haunted area in Glowing Hills
--Over a dozen new maps to explore...if you dare!
--New ghostly enemy variants
--2 new minibosses
--New item! Brave the haunted cottage to find the frag “cookie cutter” and unlock three new Halloween attack patterns for your frag grenades! Time for some festive fragging!

Spooky Grenade Note:
--After finding the new frag "cookie cutter", equip a frag grenade in combat and use Tab or the mouse wheel to see the new Halloween versions!

Bugs:
--Fixed issue with some ambient tracks not fading in/out correctly

notes.title: State of the Wasteland
notes.notes:
Hello Wasteland Warriors!
 
OUTTA GAS has been out for a few weeks now, so I want to give an update on the state of the game and where things are headed next.
 
First of all, thank you for all your support! The game has been getting great feedback and attention, and I want to share my appreciation with you all - thank you!
 
What’s Next:
--Demo coming out Thursday, April 16th
--Implement some extra achievements
--Add some quality-of-life improvements for players
--Add some additional UI help for new players
--Finish some things I didn’t get to do before release
--Continued bug-fixing
 
It’s still too early to talk about it now, but I will say that I have plans for new content. Not sure when work will start or when it’ll be coming out, so stay tuned!
 
Hope you’re enjoying your time in the wastes!
 
-Trevor

notes.title: OUTTA GAS Has Left Early Access - Full Release Now Available!!!
notes.notes:
I'm pleased to announce that OUTTA GAS has left Early Access and is now fully released on Steam! All content now available!

With 30+ hours of content spread across four distinct acts, over 70 monsters, more than 25 weapons, heaps of upgrades and passive items, and much more, OUTTA GAS will be one hell of a ride you'll never forget! Nope, nothing's quite like it...

I'd like to thank everyone that helped make Early Access such an enjoyable and productive time. Your time and effort has made OUTTA GAS an even greater experience and is much appreciated! Thank you!

And welcome to all you new wasteland-hardened badasses joining us! Please join us on the [url=https://discord.gg/q7fscxQ]Discord server[/url] community and share in this adventure. I'd love to meet you and hear what you think of OUTTA GAS!

Other than Discord, the Steam community discussion board is open for you to post any thoughts you have on the game or about any issues you run into. I'm here to help and will look into these ASAP!

Enjoy!

--Trevor

notes.title: OUTTA GAS: Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
I am incredibly excited to announce that [b]OUTTA GAS[/b], my post-apocalyptic RPG, is now available for PC on Steam in Early Access! Gain immediate access to the first portion of Sucky Pond and the following content:
[list]
[*] Innovative Turn-Based SHOOTING GALLERY Combat
[*] 6 Devastating Weapons
[*] 8 Deadly Monsters
[*] 2 Hulking Minibosses
[*] Over 12 Upgrades
[*] 5 Passive Items
[*] Over 12 Unlockable Abilities
[*] Grenades and More!
[/list]

Over the next few months, additional content will regularly unlock, adding new locations, monsters, weapons, and other content. This roadmap will culminate with the full release of [b]OUTTA GAS,[/b] where four full acts, over 70 monsters, more than 25 weapons, hundreds of upgrades, and much more await you! Find the gas you need to get back on the road to the Party at the End of the World!

[b]OUTTA GAS[/b] retails for $19.99, but for the first week after launch you can enjoy a 10% discount until January 28th to celebrate this most excellent event!

Connect with the [b]OUTTA GAS[/b] community and give your feedback here on Steam or on Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/q7fscxQ]https://discord.gg/q7fscxQ[/url]). Looking forward to hearing from you!

Now go kill some wasteland monsters!

-Trevor
